stories.title: Resident demands rule changes after recall bid over data center vote fails
stories.dek: A Michigan voter tried to oust local officials who backed a data center project and lost. She is now pushing broader changes to how such votes are handled. Readers across the state see how one township fight could shape future projects and accountability.
stories.source_title: Her effort to recall officials over data center vote was rejected. Now she’s calling for reform. - MLive.com

stories.title: Golf course next to Oracle's Saline site sold to data center firm
stories.dek: Related Digital bought Rustic Glen to expand near the $43B Oracle campus. The purchase adds pressure on Washtenaw roads, power lines and water use. Nearby homeowners could see construction lasting years.
stories.source_title: Data center developer buys golf course next to massive Oracle construction site - Crain's Detroit

stories.title: Ypsilanti Township blocks new power lines to slow data center rush
stories.dek: The township approved a moratorium on major electric infrastructure that would otherwise feed large new facilities. Residents worry about strained grids, higher bills, and industrial-scale development without local say. The move directly targets the power demands that data centers require to operate.
stories.source_title: Ypsilanti Township passes moratorium on new major electric infrastructure - WEMU

stories.title: Ypsilanti Township freezes new data center projects
stories.dek: The township enacted a land-use moratorium that blocks data center proposals while officials study impacts on roads, power and noise. Residents 30 miles away in Ann Arbor and beyond could see ripple effects on regional growth and utility rates. The pause gives local leaders time to set rules before big projects lock in.
stories.source_title: Ypsilanti Township issues land-use moratorium impacting data centers - The Eastern Echo

stories.title: Saline presses state on data center wastewater permit
stories.dek: Township officials want EGLE to explain how a proposed data center would handle millions of gallons of wastewater and protect local wells. The answers will decide whether the project moves forward or faces stricter limits. Downstream communities share the same aquifer and treatment systems.
stories.source_title: Saline wants answers from EGLE on proposed data center wastewater permit - WEMU

stories.title: Oakland County data center project reaches make-or-break vote
stories.dek: A proposed facility faces a pivotal local decision while lawsuits and state rules create uncertainty. Residents could see changes in power demand and tax revenue if the project advances. The outcome will set precedent for similar proposals across metro Detroit suburbs.
stories.source_title: Data center in Oakland County faces critical vote amid legal, regulatory hurdles - Crain's Detroit

stories.title: Developer snaps up Saline golf course to make way for server farm
stories.dek: The purchase of Rustic Glen positions the developer to convert recreational land into a large-scale facility. Washtenaw County taxpayers and neighbors will feel effects on property values, water use, and local taxes. The move follows earlier tax-break talks for the same company.
stories.source_title: Related Digital Acquires Rustic Glen Golf Course - The Saline Post

stories.title: Mason-area residents fight proposed data center over noise and power strain
stories.dek: Neighbors near Mason are organizing against a new data center project in Ingham County. The facility would add significant electricity demand and potential constant noise to a rural area already concerned about industrial growth. Local pushback could shape how quickly data centers expand around Lansing.
stories.source_title: Community opposes proposed data center near Mason - WLNS 6 News

stories.title: Caledonia Township tightens land rules that could block data centers
stories.dek: Caledonia Township in Kent County is rewriting its special land-use rules, a step that will decide whether large data-center projects can locate there. Residents 30 miles away should care because the outcome sets the template for power demand, noise, and tax revenue across western Michigan. The meeting focused on ordinance details that will govern future proposals.
stories.source_title: Caledonia Township held a Public Meating to Continue Discussing Their Special Land Use Ordinance - The Collegiate Live

stories.title: Carrollton data-center developers bar reporters from public session
stories.dek: Developers seeking to build in Carrollton Township, Saginaw County, held an information meeting but refused media access. The closed-door approach leaves residents without details on power needs, water use, or tax offers that would affect the mid-Michigan grid and local bills. The episode raises transparency questions for any future project in the area.
stories.source_title: Data center developers host info meeting in Carrollton; deny media access - WHAS11

stories.title: Coldwater drafts rules to steer data center growth
stories.dek: Township officials heard from a consultant on how to limit building size, noise and power use. The draft ordinance would give local boards more say over where centers can locate. Residents nearby could face fewer surprise projects and clearer limits on industrial sprawl.
stories.source_title: Coldwater hears expert as it drafts data center control ordinance - Coldwater Daily Reporter

national.title: Data centers advance rapidly as regulators scramble for rules
national.dek: Across the U.S., officials race to impose guardrails on power-hungry facilities while communities push back on incentives and impacts.

meetings.topic: Public hearing and recommendation on zoning ordinance text amendment for data centers, including definitions, standards for noise, water use, energy efficiency and decommissioning
Public hearing and recommendation on zoning text amendment establishing definitions, standards and locations for data centers including noise, water, energy and decommissioning rules
